description: Defines a TransactionModel class representing a financial transaction with serialization/deserialization methods, an enum for transaction types, and utility functions for string conversion.

classes.name: TransactionModel
classes.description: Represents a financial transaction with fields for id, date, amount, category, description, and type; includes methods for cloning, JSON serialization, and string representation.

methods.name: transactionTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a TransactionType enum value, defaulting to 'expense' for unrecognized strings.

methods.name: transactionTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a TransactionType enum value to its string representation.
